about: Third held-out set: written on 2026-11-21, after the 0.1.2 changes were made and frozen, and before any model answered them. Its tools (get_gym, get_flight_times, get_flat, get_recipe, get_report) were new then. Times, quotes, summaries and yes/no answers are judged by hand (no values listed). Same format as questions.json.
